Inside the 10-Entity Multimodal Graph & 8 Data Hygiene Fixes Over PrimeKG

Why Last Year's PrimeKG Ranked Congenital Vein Anomalies #1 for Biologics — and How OptimusKG Eliminated Every Artifact

10 Connected Node Types
26.7k Genes · 25.8k BioProc · 19.3k Pheno · 18.6k Drugs · 18.0k Dis.
998 Biologic Twins Unified
Merges Split ChEMBL + DrugBank Nodes (Tezepelumab, Inebilizumab)
55,952 Pure PD Drug-Targets
9,119 CYP3A4/ABCB1 ADME Metabolism Edges Isolated from MoA
47,892 MONDO DAG Edges
Masks 786 Generic Disease Umbrellas & 1-4 Hop Label Near-Duplicates
Fix 1 — Coordinate-Frame & Tensor Index Integrity: Legacy PrimeKG scripts indexed predictions by raw CSV row order and dropped frozen initial embeddings H^(0) on reload (pushing Inebilizumab NMOSD #7 -> #14,459); OptimusKG persists exact SHA-256 id2idx + inp_emb.pt (<1e-6 reload drift).
Fix 2 — Biologic Twin Unification & Fc/Complement Cleaning: Unified 998 split (CHEMBL*, DRUGBANK:*) biologic twins and stripped non-specific Fc-receptor (FCGR*) & complement (C1Q*) mAb bindings plus uncalibrated cosine fallbacks.
Fix 3 — Strict Pharmacodynamic (PD) vs. Pharmacokinetic (ADME) Separation: Isolated 9,119 CYP450/transporter metabolism edges (drug_pk_protein) and 810k PK DDIs so shared CYP3A4 clearance never masquerades as shared therapeutic mechanism.
Fix 4 — Ontology & Label-Toxicity Hygiene: Removed 18,697 non-disease measurement traits ('urate measurement'), masked 786 broad MONDO umbrellas ('nervous system disorder'), and blocked drug-induced adverse events via OnSIDES v3.1.1.

PART 2 · WHAT MODELS WE HAVE TRAINED: PURPOSE & FEATURES OPTIMUSKG · MODELS · APPS · AMG 757 & AMG 691

Foundation GNN Design: O(N d^2) Scaling, Multimodal Priors & Cold Targets

Why Frozen-H^(0) Width Scaling + Negative-Mix Calibration Unlocks 34.5% Hits@20 Even on Zero-Precedent Novel Targets

15x Lower GPU Memory
Relation-Mean-First SpMM Scales Cleanly to d=3072 (944.2M Params)
Frozen H^(0) Prevents Overfit
Trainable Wide Node Tables Memorize Degree; Frozen H^(0) Generalizes
90.5% Class-Precedent Hits@20
Blinded Cold-Target Holdout (n=95, MedRank = 3.0 / 16,992 Diseases)
34.5% Zero-Precedent Hits@20
Strictly Novel Target-Disease Pairs (n=29, 293x Random) in 0.96s CPU
Architectural Breakthrough — O(N d^2) Relation-Mean-First HeteroRGCN: Aggregating neighbor features via sparse CSR SpMM before multiplying relation matrices W_r^(l) cuts memory 15x, enabling d=2048 (420M) and d=3072 (944.2M) full-graph training without mini-batch neighbor-sampling variance.
Dual Negative-Sampling Calibration (u=0.2 + u=0.5): Combining degree-proportional (80% hard negatives, sharp local discrimination) with 50% uniform negatives suppresses false-positive logit saturation on zero-indication preclinical drugs.
Gated Multimodal Node Priors (v5fm): Zero-initialized residual gates h_tilde^(0) = Drop(h_id^(0)) + tanh(g)*Adapter(f) fuse 768-D MedCPT clinical definitions, 75-D SMILES chemistry, and 6-D gnomAD constraint without destabilizing early message passing.
Zero-Drift Inductive Target Projection (<1s CPU): New confidential AMG-XXXX assets with 0 KG edges project signed target sets through trained W_rev_drug_protein^(2) + 1-hop Open Targets L2G—recovering Obesity (#1, q=0.047) & T2D (#3) for MariTide purely from GLP1R+/GIPR-!

OptimusCombo-Net (Goal 2): Trained on 53,952 clinical triples across 203 MONDO families. Strictly zeroing all 8 heuristic-overlapping features on 15,712 real ClinicalTrials.gov multi-agent vs comparator trials yields 0.9714 5-fold MONDO-blocked AUROC (0.9343 Amgen-drug-cold).
Why Option-2 OptimusBiTE-Head Was Built: Frozen drug-level GNNs cannot see ectodomain synapse geometry (~105 kDa DLL3), slow internalization (which doomed DLL3 ADCs like Rova-T while favoring membrane-resident BiTEs!), or vital-organ sink toxicity.
Colab G4 g4_max Architecture: Combines all 24 OptimusKG checkpoints + ESM-2 3B (2,560-D extracellular domain embeddings) + 32-D HPA/GTEx/DepMap surfaceome via SVD-LoRA (K=48) + per-modality bilinear adapters across TCE, ADC, CAR-T, RLT & mAb.
Strict Antigen-Cold Validation (10x5 CV, 0 Target Leakage): Triples Direction-A indication MRR (0.1187 -> 0.3595, Hits@10 = 57.4%) and boosts Direction-B 2,381-surfaceome discovery 20.4x (MRR 0.0120 -> 0.2454).
